name: Teachers
oneLiner: Real-time reading of other humans, in a room, with a duty of care.
why: A teacher reads the room continuously and changes plan mid-sentence
Parents and institutions require a responsible adult in the building
The role is indivisible: every school still needs the seat filled
threats: Lesson prep, marking and reporting are all being automated around the role
Clickwork tutoring products compete at the margins of the job

claims.text: McKinsey places teachers among occupations with lower disruption because the work depends heavily on physical presence, regulation and human interaction.
Occupations are bundles of interdependent activities, and some are indivisible — every school still requires a principal, every hospital a medical director.
